newsitem.title: USA: Fed seen refraining from open market operations.
newsitem.headline: Fed seen refraining from open market operations.

text.p: The Federal Reserve is expected to refrain from open market operations on Friday, market analysts said.

"In the final six days of the reserve period we see a daily add need of about $3.3 billion," said Dana Saporta, economist at Stone & McCarthy Research Associates Inc. "With funds so soft today it looks like the Fed can wait."
Analysts at MMS International and MCM MoneyWatch were also calling for no action from the Fed.
At 1050 EDT/1450 GMT, the federal funds rate stood at 5-1/8 percent, below the Fed's 5-1/4 percent target.
